acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Implement Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) algorithm for chunk selection
Support three diversity modes: balanced (λ=0.5), aggressive (λ=0.7), minimal (no filtering)
Diversity filter applied after semantic search, before returning results
Measurable reduction in chunk overlap (logged metric)
No significant latency increase (< 50ms for typical result sets)

constraints.constraint: MMR Formula: Score = λ * relevance - (1-λ) * max_sim_to_selected
Similarity computed using numpy cosine_similarity on embeddings
If all chunks highly similar, MMR will still select k items
